authority: User correction: high-quality painting photograph != high-pixel-count photograph. Mobile display, not museum printing.

mobileQualityPolicy.visualTarget: Full painting rendered with contain-fitting at a typical ~390 CSS px screen width, within available screen height; check colour, tonal range, visible painterly detail and edge integrity
mobileQualityPolicy.reproductionFit: A clean 700–1200 pixel photograph may be fully satisfactory at this scale. Higher pixel dimensions do not earn preference if image quality or subject fit is worse.
mobileQualityPolicy.resolutionGate: NO_FIXED_MINIMUM_AND_NO_AUTOMATIC_REJECTION_AT_1200PX_OR_2000PX. Distinguish technical decode from mobile appearance; record source width/height for reference only.
mobileQualityPolicy.originalIdentity: Exact selected physical painting, depicted saint and correct painted side must be verified; different original is a distinct candidate and cannot inherit rating.
mobileQualityPolicy.frameHandling: External frame may be present in acquired source; create independent cropped derivative after confirmation that every edge of painting is included. Do not remove parts of the painting.
mobileQualityPolicy.rights: Review file-specific and institution-specific licensing for prospective public/commercial app. A research acquisition is not a distribution licence.
mobileQualityPolicy.preview: On-device 390px contain-fit visual inspection should judge real display adequacy, not print-grade original resolution.
mobileQualityPolicy.release: Record MOBILE_VISUALLY_SUITABLE, EXACT_ORIGINAL_CONFIRMED, RIGHTS_COMPATIBLE, CURATOR_APPROVED separately. Never conflate them.
